summary: Leclerc hunts Antonelli in Austin as the Mercedes rookie sits on the cusp of his maiden world championship, with Ferrari seeking to capitalize on track conditions that have frustrated rivals like Verstappen. The treacherous bumps plaguing the Circuit of the Americas present a wild card that could disrupt established hierarchies, potentially favoring teams with superior suspension setup over raw pace. A victory for Antonelli would seal the title with races remaining, while Leclerc desperately needs points to keep Ferrari's slim championship hopes alive.
